d:
Lower back pain is a common problem that can affect spinal mobility, muscle strength and everyday activities. Long hours of sitting, poor movement habits and muscular weakness can contribute to stiffness and discomfort. Gentle yoga and regular movement can help improve mobility, strengthen supporting muscles and make daily movements more comfortable.
In this session, Hansaji guides you through a gentle yoga routine for lower back pain that you can practise regularly over three weeks.
In this routine, you will learn:
1. Gentle movements to prepare the spine, hips and knees.
